description: Returns current statistics about the Veterans’ Rights archive: the number of vetted Board of Veterans’ Appeals decisions, the distribution of outcomes (granted / denied / remanded / mixed), the date range the decisions cover, and the number of accredited representatives in the directory. Shows how much data the archive holds and how current it is. Counts reflect only quality-filtered, publicly visible decisions.
